etymology.historical_story: Carmichael began as a place name in Lanarkshire, Scotland, before becoming a surname. Its historical elements connect a Brittonic word for a fort with the personal name Michael. The name therefore preserves a landscape association rather than a Malay meaning. These historical elements are not productive Malay affixes. [Source: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig name guide](https://www3.smo.uhi.ac.uk/gaidhlig/faclair/cuspair/Ainmean_Pearsanta.pdf).
